# sequentialist-agentic

> Application software for tool-using agents, bounded source retrieval and finite reasoning examples.
> Mathematical algorithms remain in sequential-search; this package supplies task semantics and adapters.

This curated reading index does not guarantee ingestion, citation or ranking by
an assistant, crawler or search service. The upstream pin in current metadata
predates the new reasoning API: development examples need matching local sources.

## Start here

- [Plain-language overview and FAQ](docs/overview.md): task choice, noncoder workflow, inputs/outputs and limits.
- [Обзор и частые вопросы на русском](docs/overview.ru.md): выбор задачи, сценарии без программирования, входы/выходы и ограничения.
- [README](README.md): setup commands, offline examples and the dependency-pin warning.
- [Repository guidance](AGENTS.md): source map and proportionate verification commands.

## Examples and implementation evidence

- [Reasoning and retrieval demo](examples/reasoning_demo.py): finite derivations and source-cited retrieval.
- [Original mock agent demo](examples/search_agent_demo.py): tool actions with no live service requirement.
- [Application tasks](src/sequentialist_agentic/tasks.py): document records, retrieval and trusted geometry rules.
- [Evaluator interfaces](src/sequentialist_agentic/evidence.py): mock evaluator and calibration limits.
- [Task tests](tests/test_tasks.py): executable examples and result boundaries.
- [Public exports](src/sequentialist_agentic/__init__.py): current import API.
- [Package metadata](pyproject.toml): actual distribution identity and pinned dependencies.
